Celtic track teenager Doumbia - gossip
- Published
Celtic monitor Ivory Coast teenager playing in Sweden as one of their Europa League opponents seek a new manager.
Celtic are among a host of clubs to have scouted BK Hacken midfielder Abdoulaye Doumbia, with Everton, Sunderland also watching the 19-year-old. (Africa Foot, external - in French)
Sheffield United are keen on Motherwell left-back Emmanuel Longelo and may bid for the 25-year-old in January. (Alan Nixon on Patreon, external)
Portuguese clubs Torreense, who will face Celtic in the Europa League, have sacked manager Luis Tralhao. (Sun, external)
Rangers midfielder Kim Min-su, 20, has been named in South Korea's Under-21 squad, having most recently been in the senior squad. (Sun, external)
With Laurent Mendy the only fit first team midfielder in Hearts' Conference League squad, Gus Stevenson and Matthew Gillies, both 19, could be involved in Thursday's meeting with Thun in Switzerland. (Edinburgh Evening News - subscription required, external)
St Johnstone forward Unax Alvarez, who is yet to feature after picking up an ankle injury in a pre-season friendly, has sustained a calf problem from a closed-doors match and still isn't back in training. (The Courier, external)
Coach Angus Beith has left Hearts for a new job after seven years in various roles at Tynecastle. (Edinburgh Evening News - subscription required, external)
Former Rangers and United States player Alejandro Bedoya has announced his retirement from football at the age of 39. (Record - subscription required, external)
